verdict.rationale: The core product, the Rive Editor, has no documented self-hosted or on-premises deployment option. Only the runtimes are open source, and they are playback libraries for .riv files that still require the Rive Editor to author content. Shipping an open-source runtime inside your own app is an adjacent capability, not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The Rive runtimes are open-source libraries that allow you to load and control your animations in apps, games, and websites.
this is an MIT license for Rive's rendering abstraction layer, a subset of the Rive runtime that requires the Rive Editor to build content for.
